title: Velvety Midnight-Craving German Vegetables Stew
description: A yeasty, velvety, and satisfying German-inspired stew with raw vegetables and a variety of textures, perfect for a late-night craving.
instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in the unsalted butter until softened.
Add the raw carrots, beets, and zucchini to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds, malt vinegar, yeast extract, and flour to the pot, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the low-sodium broth, water, heavy cream, salt, black pepper, ginger, parsley, thyme, and capers to the pot, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes.
If using, add the hard-boiled egg to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the stew to individual mini cocottes or stone bowls and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional parsley and thyme, if desired.
Serve hot and enjoy the creamy, comforting flavors of this velvety midnight-craving German stew.
Let the stew cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing, if not serving immediately.
To reheat, place the stew in a saucepan over low heat and add a splash of low-sodium broth or water if needed to prevent scorching.
